subject: Finlytics POC - success criteria, plan, and weekly status
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@finlytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Finlytics POC - success criteria & next steps

Thanks for the call this morning — great to meet the Finlytics team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kickoff:

1) Success criteria (proposed)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for 512-token requests on your representative queries
- Throughput: sustain 50 req/min for peak batch tests
- Quality: Rouge-L / business metric: >= current baseline for entity extraction (we'll coordinate on exact eval prompts)
- Stability: no more than 2 service interruptions during 2-week trial window

2) Evaluation plan
- Week 0: infra setup + sample data upload (you)
- Week 1: baseline runs, metric collection, initial tuning (Redwood SE)
- Week 2: focused tests on edge cases, final report and recommendation

3) Timelines and ownership
- Sample data & service account: Finlytics (Ethan) by 2026-07-01
- Network/VPC requirements & IAM: Marcus (Redwood) by 2026-06-25
- Baseline runs & initial tuning: Marcus/Neha by 2026-07-06

4) Next steps
- I attached a draft success_criteria spreadsheet and our network requirements PDF for your infra team to review (see attachments).
- Can you confirm the data type/format and whether there are any PII concerns we should sandbox?
- Are you good with weekly check-ins on Wednesdays?

If that all looks good I'll schedule the kickoff for the week of June 29th and loop in infra.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: finlytics_poc_success_criteria.xlsx, network_requirements.pdf

From: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-23T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics POC - success criteria & next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick items from our side:

- Success criteria: overall looks good. For quality, we prefer to validate with our anonymized transaction logs (we'll provide a 1% sample). Can we add one mid-point metric: precision@50 for our entity matcher?
- Data/PII: we'll redact direct identifiers but there are structured account IDs that remain — we'll provide a data dictionary.
- Timeline: July 1 data upload is fine. Can you confirm how we should provide a service account or temporary key for the POC environment?

Also looping in Priya (product) who will be our internal owner for the evaluation. Marcus — can you confirm when you expect to have the VPC/IP allowlist ready?

Thanks,
Ethan
Director of Data Product, Finlytics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-24T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics POC - success criteria & next steps

Perfect — thanks Ethan. Responses inline:

- precision@50: happy to add that as a tracked metric. We'll update the success_criteria sheet and share back.
- Service account: we prefer a short-lived service account key for the trial. I'll have Marcus send a one-page instructions doc for creating the account and scoping permissions.
- VPC/IP allowlist: Marcus, can you confirm target IPs and when you'll need the network team to approve?

Neha — I'm assigning you to own the eval prompts and final report (deliverable end of Week 2). Marcus will handle infra. Ethan/Priya — can you confirm sample data format and whether you'll be uploading to our signed S3 endpoint or giving us an SFTP link?

I'll schedule the kickoff call tentatively for 2026-06-29 10:00 AM PT — open to moving if that doesn't work for your team.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: updated_finlytics_success_criteria.xlsx (v1)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics POC - infra prep & access

Quick infra update from my side:

- VPC peering and IP allowlist: configured. I pushed the target IPs and firewall rules to the network doc (see sample_data_instructions.txt attached).
- Service account: I need a short-lived key (JSON) with read access to the sample dataset. Ethan — once you upload to the signed S3 location, send me the presigned URL or the service account key and I'll wire up the baseline tests.
- Estimated baseline run time: first pass (500 requests) ~45 minutes on our baseline cluster; I'll provision a larger instance if you want parallel runs.

Blocking items: sample data and confirmation on PII handling so I can mask fields where necessary.

I'll be on the kickoff call and will bring a checklist for the initial runs.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: sample_data_instructions.txt

From: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics POC - infra prep & access

Thanks Marcus — we'll upload the 1% sample to the signed S3 location tomorrow (2026-07-01) and send the presigned URL to you.

On cadence: weekly check-ins on Wednesdays work for us. Can we target a 30-minute sync focused on progress + action items? Also, for reporting: can you include precision@50 and the latency p95 in the baseline report so we can track against the success criteria?

I'll flag Priya as the internal owner for the evaluation and she'll be on the weekly calls.

Ethan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Finlytics POC - Week 0 status update & kickoff reminder

Hi all — quick weekly status and next-step nudge ahead of the kickoff:

Status:
- Network/VPC: complete (Marcus)
- Service account/key: pending (Ethan) — please send presigned S3 URL or key by EOD 2026-07-01
- Sample data: scheduled for upload 2026-07-01 (Finlytics)
- Eval prompts & metrics: Neha will share the evaluation prompt set by 2026-07-02

Action items (owners):
- Ethan: upload sample & send presigned URL (due 2026-07-01)
- Marcus: baseline cluster & run plan (due 2026-07-02)
- Neha: eval prompts & final success_criteria sheet (due 2026-07-02)
- Marissa: schedule weekly Wednesday 30-min syncs starting 2026-07-08 and send calendar invite

Please reply if any of the dates look tight. If we don't receive the sample by EOD today I'll push the kickoff to July 6 to ensure adequate time for baseline prep.

Thanks and talk soon — I'll schedule the kickoff for 2026-07-02 10:00 AM PT tentatively and will adjust if needed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
